note: Another wanderer on the walkie-talkie. Seeded order per run. Each one teaches something true.
lines: keep looking at it. it only moves when nobody's looking
the wall maps lie. one in four. check the ones you can see for yourself
tie string at a light. then you can always get back to the light
if you have to run, run toward the buzzing ones
drop the recorder playing and walk away. it'll go and listen
the camera flash. it doesn't like the flash
the drawers that stick are the ones worth coming back to
don't trust the chalk. the walls move under it
we're on channel two. if you hear three, switch off
the machine ate my last coin. kick it, it doesn't help
badges. keep the badges. some doors still read them
count the doors. then count them again on the way back
it's quieter on this floor. that's not good
who's this. who's on this channel. say something
